model: double-group line matrix plus direct point-plane connector
plane_connector_model: Point-plane restriction on the plane generic unitary basis with explicit double-valued raw characters.

plane_blocks.connector_model: Direct point-plane restriction onto the plane generic unitary basis. The geometric boundary lines are not promoted to separate unknown-bearing manifolds.
plane_blocks.boundary_model_note: single_group_connectivity.json still has line_plane = []. The boundary lines of S1/S2 are geometric-only objects rather than separately listed special-line manifolds, so a boundary-line chain through explicit line unknowns is not available. The minimal viable double-group connector is therefore direct restriction from each corner point to the plane generic basis.
